$comment: Server-generated parity fixture for glasses pairing (docs/pairing-contract.md). server/lib/glasses-pairing.test.ts fails if any value here stops matching what the server produces. Clients copy it; never hand-edit it.

reasonMessages.bad_request: That pairing request was not understood. Scan the code again.
reasonMessages.not_loopback: Pairing codes are made only by COS Control on this Mac.
reasonMessages.not_allowed_network: Connect over Tailscale, or turn on "Allow pairing on this Wi-Fi" in COS Control.
reasonMessages.denied: Pairing was denied on the Mac.
reasonMessages.unknown_code: This code is not current. Show a new one in COS Control.
reasonMessages.used: This code was already used. Show a new one in COS Control.
reasonMessages.locked: Too many tries, or another device is waiting. Show a new code in COS Control.
reasonMessages.expired: Code expired: show a new one in COS Control.
reasonMessages.rate_limited: Too many tries. Wait a minute and try again.
reasonMessages.draining: Your Mac is updating. Try again in a minute.
